description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ConfigFileAPI' which extends an API controller for handling configuration file-related API requests in an installer context. It includes methods for handling POST requests to process database configuration information, potentially write encryption keys, and manage registration status during the installation process.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for handling API requests related to configuration files during the installer process in OrangeHRM. It extends an upgrader API class and overrides methods to process database info and registration data.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to configure database info, possibly writes encryption keys if requested, and updates the application state accordingly. Overrides a parent method to extend functionality.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns a specific registration type constant indicating the installer has started.
